verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe a sandbox that lets you use BigQuery without a credit card or billing account, at no cost, to evaluate fit. A documented free tier also covers 10 GiB of storage and 1 TiB of queries per month, so real queries on real data are possible with no sales contact. Missing for 10: the sandbox's specific limitations are undocumented (it is described only as 'limited BigQuery capabilities'), and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of a no-card sandbox evaluation.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can evaluate with a free tier or trial — real queries on real data without a credit card or a sales call

citations.quote: The BigQuery sandbox lets you experience BigQuery without providing a credit card or creating a billing account for your project.
The BigQuery sandbox lets you explore limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost to confirm whether BigQuery fits your needs.
Store 10 GiB of data and run up to 1 TiB of queries for free per month.
The first 1 TiB of query data processed per month is free.
